Dynamic Simple Knock System SKSE
Version 1.0.0

Look at the locked door of somebody's home and the prompt says Knock. Press your activate control, on keyboard or controller.

By day they let you in with a "Come in." At night only a friend gets in. A refusal changes nothing: the door stays locked and you can still pick it. Sneaking always gives you the lock.

No plugin, no scripts, no patches. It reads who owns the door or the space behind it while you play, so a door from any mod works, and nobody needs to carry a key.

Left alone: your own home, doors you hold the key to, dungeons, places with anybody hostile to you, doors between two interiors, and the [Exclusions] list in the INI.

Do not use it together with Simpler Knock or its patches.

Settings: an optional page in the Apocrypha Menu Framework or SKSE Menu Framework (enable, day start, night start), and the INI, SKSE\Plugins\DynamicSimpleKnock.ini.

Requires SKSE and Address Library. Skyrim SE 1.5.97, AE 1.6.1170, and 1.7.99 / 1.7.104.
